# Presentations

This page is an index for presentation materials that are intended to be shared by direct link.

No presentation decks have been added yet. Future slides should use the structure:

```text
presentations/
  topic-name/
    yyyy-mm-event-name/
      index.html
```

Example direct links will look like:

- `/presentations/acoustic-streaming/2025-07-wuwangyi/`
- `/presentations/three-link-rl/2025-prfluids/`
